limitations: Only windowed local extrema is implemented; no reversal-threshold, ATR, prominence, or hierarchical algorithm exists.
No default configuration is supplied; callers own every geometry parameter.
The fixed bar window spans different clock time across timeframes and market closures.
DEVELOPING observations may move or disappear when later bars arrive.
An incomplete current Yahoo weekly or monthly bar is not separately tagged by the provider; geometry state refers only to the right-window contract.
A bar selected as both the local high and local low is excluded and diagnosed.
Duplicate input timestamps fail closed rather than being merged or selected.
No high/low alternation, endpoint replacement, pruning, minimum separation, or scale hierarchy is imposed.
No output proves importance, a completed Elliott swing, an Elliott endpoint, family, degree, validity, or forecast.
Automatic output cannot directly satisfy explicit-pivot or observed-price methodology contracts.
Timeframe and discovery parameters never imply Elliott degree.
The NVDA experiment is a transient external-data observation, not a durable market claim.
historical_immutability: Only pivots with a complete bounded right window are stable under appended bars; this is algorithmic geometry stability, not physical artifact immutability.
